speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for clarifying; the postnasal drip and worsening at night strongly suggest a post-nasal drip syndrome or GERD. Have you noticed any heartburn, sour taste in your mouth, or regurgitation, especially after meals or when lying down? Also, do you have a history of seasonal allergies or sinus infections?

speaker: Patient
text: Yes, I do experience occasional heartburn and sometimes feel a sour taste in my mouth, particularly after eating or when I lie down to sleep. I also have a known history of seasonal allergies which often leads to nasal congestion and postnasal drip.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) with concurrent Post-Nasal Drip Syndrome. The combination of nocturnal cough, sour taste, heartburn, and known allergic rhinitis points to reflux as the primary driver of your chronic cough.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Chronic Cough secondary to Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD)
